WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position
), shares AS (
    SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM member_attendance
), ranked AS (
    SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank
    FROM shares
)
SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC;
